# A variable-size make that reaches a cgo call argument or an
# unsafe.Pointer conversion heaps its backing store; the same make without
# those flows uses the stack buffer. A fixed-effective-capacity make keeps
# ordinary escape behavior instead: it stays on the stack with no flow or
# with only a dereferenced unsafe.Pointer, and it heaps only when ordinary
# escape says so (a cgo call argument).
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1

cd m
go test -count=1 .
logos test -count=1 .
go test -count=1 -O=3 .
logos test -count=1 -O=3 .

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/stackbufflows

go 1.27

-- m/flow.go --
package stackbufflows

/*
#include <stdint.h>
static uint8_t firstByte(uint8_t *p) { return p ? *p : 0; }
*/
import "C"

import "unsafe"

//go:noinline
func control(n int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, n)
	b[0] = 7
	return b[n-1]
}

//go:noinline
func unsafeFlow(n int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, n)
	b[0] = 7
	up := unsafe.Pointer(&b[0])
	return *(*byte)(up)
}

//go:noinline
func cgoFlow(n int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, n)
	b[0] = 7
	return byte(C.firstByte((*C.uint8_t)(unsafe.Pointer(&b[0]))))
}

//go:noinline
func cgoDirectFlow(n int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, n)
	b[0] = 7
	return byte(C.firstByte((*C.uint8_t)(&b[0])))
}

//go:noinline
func controlConst() byte {
	b := make([]byte, 16)
	b[0] = 7
	return b[15]
}

//go:noinline
func unsafeFlowConst() byte {
	b := make([]byte, 16)
	b[0] = 7
	up := unsafe.Pointer(&b[0])
	return *(*byte)(up)
}

//go:noinline
func cgoFlowConst() byte {
	b := make([]byte, 16)
	b[0] = 7
	return byte(C.firstByte((*C.uint8_t)(unsafe.Pointer(&b[0]))))
}

//go:noinline
func cgoDirectFlowConst() byte {
	b := make([]byte, 16)
	b[0] = 7
	return byte(C.firstByte((*C.uint8_t)(&b[0])))
}

//go:noinline
func controlConstCap() byte {
	b := make([]byte, 0, 16)
	b = append(b, 7)
	return b[0]
}

//go:noinline
func unsafeFlowConstCap() byte {
	b := make([]byte, 0, 16)
	b = append(b, 7)
	up := unsafe.Pointer(&b[0])
	return *(*byte)(up)
}

//go:noinline
func controlExplicitCap(n int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, 0, n)
	b = b[:1]
	b[0] = 7
	return b[0]
}

//go:noinline
func unsafeFlowExplicitCap(n int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, 0, n)
	b = b[:1]
	b[0] = 7
	up := unsafe.Pointer(&b[0])
	return *(*byte)(up)
}

//go:noinline
func cgoFlowExplicitCap(n int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, 0, n)
	b = b[:1]
	b[0] = 7
	return byte(C.firstByte((*C.uint8_t)(unsafe.Pointer(&b[0]))))
}
-- m/flow_test.go --
package stackbufflows

import "testing"

func TestStackBufferFlows(t *testing.T) {
	const n = 16
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = control(n) }); got != 0 {
		t.Errorf("control make took %v allocations, want none (stack buffer)", got)
	}
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = unsafeFlow(n) }); got < 1 {
		t.Errorf("unsafe.Pointer make took %v allocations, want the heap", got)
	}
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = cgoFlow(n) }); got < 1 {
		t.Errorf("cgo make took %v allocations, want the heap", got)
	}
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = cgoDirectFlow(n) }); got < 1 {
		t.Errorf("direct cgo make took %v allocations, want the heap", got)
	}
}

func TestStackBufferFixedCapFlows(t *testing.T) {
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = controlConst() }); got != 0 {
		t.Errorf("fixed-cap control make took %v allocations, want none (ordinary escape)", got)
	}
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = unsafeFlowConst() }); got != 0 {
		t.Errorf("fixed-cap unsafe.Pointer make took %v allocations, want none (ordinary escape)", got)
	}
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = controlConstCap() }); got != 0 {
		t.Errorf("fixed-cap control make took %v allocations, want none (ordinary escape)", got)
	}
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = unsafeFlowConstCap() }); got != 0 {
		t.Errorf("fixed-cap unsafe.Pointer make took %v allocations, want none (ordinary escape)", got)
	}
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = cgoFlowConst() }); got < 1 {
		t.Errorf("fixed-cap cgo make took %v allocations, want the heap (ordinary escape)", got)
	}
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = cgoDirectFlowConst() }); got < 1 {
		t.Errorf("fixed-cap direct cgo make took %v allocations, want the heap (ordinary escape)", got)
	}
}

func TestStackBufferExplicitCapFlows(t *testing.T) {
	const n = 16
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = controlExplicitCap(n) }); got != 0 {
		t.Errorf("explicit-cap control make took %v allocations, want none (stack buffer)", got)
	}
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = unsafeFlowExplicitCap(n) }); got < 1 {
		t.Errorf("explicit-cap unsafe.Pointer make took %v allocations, want the heap", got)
	}
	if got := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { _ = cgoFlowExplicitCap(n) }); got < 1 {
		t.Errorf("explicit-cap cgo make took %v allocations, want the heap", got)
	}
}
